definitions.text_mt: Bajja maħsuba u mibnija bir-rimm u l-moll fejn jormaw il-vapuri.

usage_examples.mt: Il-vapur daħal fil-port il-Kbir kmieni filgħodu.
usage_examples.en: The ship entered the Grand Harbour early in the morning.

entries.audit_notes: ℹ️ **[Loanword]** Valid Maltese loanword (*port* = harbour/seaport; pl. *portijiet*)

definitions.text_mt: Li għandu x'jaqsam ma' belt fl-użu u t-tifsira uffiċjali.
Spazju jew parti minn bini magħluqa b'ħitan, saqaf u bieb.
Sala jew kamra użata għal laqgħat uffiċjali jew organizzazzjoni ta' assoċjazzjoni.

usage_examples.mt: Dħalt fil-kamra tas-sodda biex nistrieħ wara jum twil xogħol.
usage_examples.en: I entered the bedroom to rest after a long day of work.

definitions.text_mt: Għodda ta' injam jew ħadid użata biex tagħlaq il-bini.

usage_examples.en: He opened the house door to enter.

definitions.text_mt: Oġġett, kwalità jew kunċett li jikkorrispondi għal race, breed, ethnicity.

usage_examples.mt: L-użu ta' razza kien prominenti u utli ħafna fil-ħajja.
usage_examples.en: The use of race, breed, ethnicity was prominent and very useful in life.

definitions.text_mt: Bini u post kbir użat biex jaħżnu l-merkanzija u l-prodotti.

usage_examples.mt: Żammew il-kaxxi tal-merkanzija fil-maħżen ewlieni tal-port.
usage_examples.en: They kept the cargo boxes in the port's main warehouse.

definitions.text_mt: Veloċità u grad ta' ħeffa f'vjaġġ.

usage_examples.mt: Il-veloċità tal-karozza kienet ta' mitt kilometru fis-siegħa.
usage_examples.en: The car speed was one hundred kilometers per hour.

definitions.text_mt: Il-parti ta' taħt nett tal-baħar, tal-bir jew tat-tazza.

usage_examples.en: They found the anchor at the bottom of the sea with the ship.

definitions.text_mt: Post u bini stabbilit fejn jaqdu l-passiġġieri fuq ferrovija jew xarabank.

usage_examples.mt: Il-ferrovija waslet fl-istazzjon ċentrali fuq il-ħin tagħha.
usage_examples.en: The train arrived at the central station right on time.

definitions.text_mt: Post miftuħ fejn jinbiegħu l-ħaxix u l-merkanzija.

usage_examples.mt: Ommna marret is-suq biex tixtri l-ħaxix u l-frott frisk.
usage_examples.en: Our mother went to the market to buy fresh vegetables and fruit.

definitions.text_mt: Ġabra ta' bini jew għaqda ta' partiti.

usage_examples.mt: Blokk ta' bini ġdid fil-belt nazzjonali.
usage_examples.en: A block of new buildings in the national city.

definitions.text_mt: Li għandu x'jaqsam ma' ċans fl-użu u t-tifsira uffiċjali.
